title: "Footnotes"

## Per-slide footnotes

Quarto gathers a slide's footnotes into an aside at the bottom of that
slide.^[The first footnote.] Each slide numbers its own footnotes from
one.^[The second footnote.]

::: {.aside}
An aside and the slide's footnotes share a single block at the bottom.
:::

## A fresh slide

Footnote numbering restarts on every slide.^[This is footnote 1 on this
slide, even though earlier slides also had footnotes.]
